quote: Trimesh uses the [Sphinx Numpy-style](https://www.sphinx-doc.org/en/master/usage/extensions/example_numpy.html#example-numpy) docstrings which get parsed into the API reference page.
statement: In trimesh/**, function and class docstrings must use the Sphinx Numpy-style format (Parameters / Returns sections).

quote: We try to add a somewhat helpful `DeprecationWarning` one year in advance of a major API change: warnings.warn("`remove_duplicate_faces` is deprecated " ... category=DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2,)
statement: In trimesh/**, deprecated public APIs should emit warnings.warn(..., category=DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2) with a message naming the removal date and replacement, about one year before removal.

quote: The most compelling issue or PR has a ~10-line standalone reproduction containing one or more strict `assert condition` that fails in the `main` branch. Adding test models is OK but undesirable.
statement: In tests/**, bug-fix tests should be short standalone reproductions using strict assert predicates, and should avoid adding new test model files under models/.

quote: In general, if you ever have a block which loops through faces and vertices it will be basically unusable with even moderately sized meshes. All operations on face or vertex arrays should be vectorized numpy operations unless absolutely unavoidable.
statement: In trimesh/**, operations on face or vertex arrays should be vectorized numpy operations and must not use Python loops over faces or vertices unless unavoidable.

quote: look for suspicious patterns: not using `numpy` operations, loops of any sort, nested loops, conditionals in loops, calling functions, O(N^2) or worse anywhere.
statement: In trimesh/**, code should use numpy operations and avoid Python loops, nested loops, conditionals inside loops and O(N^2) algorithms.

quote: Generally `trimesh` API changes should have a one-year period of [printing a `warnings.DeprecationWarning`](https://trimesh.org/contributing.html#deprecations) although that's not always possible
statement: In trimesh/**, public API changes should keep the old API emitting a DeprecationWarning for one year before removal.
In all Python files, code must pass ruff flake8-bugbear (B) rules.
In all Python files, code must pass ruff C rules (flake8-comprehensions; mccabe C901 is ignored).
In all Python files, code must pass ruff pycodestyle error (E) rules.
In all Python files, code must pass ruff Pyflakes (F) rules (no unused imports/variables, undefined names).
In all Python files, imports must be sorted per ruff isort (I) rules.
In all Python files, code must pass ruff-specific (RUF) rules (RUF005 ignored).
In all Python files, code must use modern Python 3.10+ syntax per ruff pyupgrade (UP) rules.
In all Python files, code must pass ruff pycodestyle warning (W) rules.
In all Python files, code must not misuse sys.version / sys.version_info comparisons (flake8-2020 YTT).
In all Python files, code must not implicitly concatenate string literals on a single line (ISC001).
In all Python files, code must not implicitly concatenate string literals across lines using backslash continuation (ISC002).
In all Python files, code must not use numpy APIs removed or renamed in NumPy 2.0 (NPY201).
In trimesh/** (outside examples, tests, helpers, docs), code must not call print() or pprint() (T20).
In all Python files (except per-file exemptions), code must not use the APIs listed in flake8-tidy-imports banned-api (TID251).
In all Python files, function complexity (C901) is not enforced.

quote: ignore = ["N802", # Function name should be lowercase
statement: In all Python files, the lowercase function-name rule (N802) is not enforced.

quote: ignore = ["N806", # Variable in function should be lowercase
statement: In all Python files, the lowercase in-function variable-name rule (N806) is not enforced.
In all Python files, the line-length lint rule (E501) is not enforced.
In all Python files, re-raising inside except without `raise ... from err` (B904) is not flagged.

quote: ignore = ["B905", # zip() without an explicit strict= parameter
statement: In all Python files, zip() calls are not required to pass strict= (B905).
In all Python files, the rule preferring unpacking over collection concatenation (RUF005) is not enforced.
In all Python files, ruff treats trimesh.typed as a typing module, so type aliases should be imported from trimesh.typed.

quote:
# don't allow implicit string concatenation
flake8-implicit-str-concat = {"allow-multiline" = false}
statement: In all Python files, string literals must not be implicitly concatenated even across multiple lines inside parentheses; use explicit + or a single literal.
In examples/*, tests/*, helpers/* and docs/*, the print ban (T20) is turned off.
In examples/* and docs/*, the banned-api rule (TID251) is turned off.
In tests/generic.py and tests/conftest.py, the banned-api rule (TID251) is turned off.

quote: "IPython.embed".msg = "you forgot to remove a debug embed ;)"
statement: In all Python files outside examples/docs and tests/{generic,conftest}.py, code must not use IPython.embed.

quote: "matplotlib".msg = "you forgot to remove a debug plot"
statement: In all Python files outside examples/docs and tests/{generic,conftest}.py, code must not import matplotlib.
In all Python files outside examples/docs and tests/{generic,conftest}.py, code must not call numpy.empty; use numpy.zeros.
In all Python files outside examples/docs and tests/{generic,conftest}.py, code must not call numpy.empty_like; use numpy.zeros / numpy.zeros_like.
